THE STARTING POINT

What are you building?

Start with an idea. We’ll use a scenario pack to explore the decisions underneath it.

Starting a new brief replaces this browser’s current draft. Export your current project first if you want to keep it.
A QUICK WALKTHROUGH

Give your idea
a dress rehearsal.

  1. 01
    Run the baseline.

    See how a deliberately incomplete workflow handles a difficult case.

  2. 02
    Choose and test a policy.

    Change a business rule, adjust the fixture, and inspect the resulting events.

  3. 03
    Save the decision. Export the plan.

    Build a brief with explicit rules, assumptions, acceptance cases, and open questions.

This version uses six deterministic scenarios in three named packs. Your idea text is saved with the brief; it does not generate new scenarios. Rehearsals specify behavior for developers to implement and test.
